g.text: 37a · Sharing a Reel card to Velora AI assistant chat
Share Reel to AI assistant chat(Reel ID, optional user prompt)
Fetch public Reel card summary & metadata
Post Reel attachment message into user-bot conversation turn
Persist user message with rich Reel card attachment
Confirm Reel shared to AI chat session
Open chat screen displaying shared Reel preview card
AI assistant receives Reel context in prompt to answer questions about the video content
